decisions.reason: As an adjacent professional-lighting product for institutional users, it likely remains close enough to aspiration for a large expanding firm to keep it unless the specialised medical niche shows sustained underperformance.

This line fits the firm's core industrial and maritime customer base and exploits its engineering and certified-manufacturing strengths, so its results are likely above aspiration and retention is strongly favored.

The office pendant luminaire is close to the established range and should benefit from industry growth and the firm's sales channels, though overlap with other offerings makes it somewhat more exposed to pruning if performance falls short of aspiration.

A premium multi-model pendant line signals stronger commitment and differentiation within the firm's core lighting business, so with organisational slack and strategic fit management would usually continue it unless margins disappoint.
